concepts.name: Editorial Studio
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity visual design proposal for the Themes section of All Set, a native macOS desktop customization app.
Primary request: Create an ORIGINAL complete app interface from scratch using your own design direction. No reference images. All theme artwork is newly invented for this concept. Show a single crisp finished application screenshot, landscape 16:10, straight-on orthographic view, full app window filling the frame with a very narrow outer margin. This is a product interface for selecting coordinated wallpaper and widget sets. Each theme thumbnail must show a wallpaper plus tiny coordinated clock, weather and calendar widgets so it reads as a desktop experience. Design with precise spacing, beautiful typography, accessible contrast, elegant line icons and highly polished original art direction. Main labels and action text must be readable. Native macOS traffic-light window controls. Use "All Set" for the product name. Include clearly selected "Themes", search, category filters, favorites hearts, and an "Apply theme" action for the featured or selected theme. Keep the interface plausible to implement in SwiftUI.
Constraints: Original visual composition and original theme art. No presentation board, no multiple alternative screens in the same image, no computer hardware mockup, no browser chrome, no marketing webpage, no code, no watermarks. Avoid existing football-player, palm-beach, mountain-cloud or city-noir imagery.
Style: warm contemporary editorial design with quiet luxury. Canvas soft ivory #F4F1EA, white cards, ink-black text, muted terracotta accent, small refined serif display title paired with native sans-serif controls. Generous whitespace and precise asymmetric bento layout. No glowing dark UI.
Layout: a slim 190px warm-white left sidebar with All Set wordmark, Themes selected in a rounded terracotta tinted row, Widgets, Wallpapers, Favorites, subtle bottom Settings. Main area top header "Themes" in elegant large serif; subtitle "Make space for your mood." Search at right. Small filter pills "Discover", "Nature", "Abstract", "Minimal" with Discover selected. Main composition: a wide feature tile on the left showing an ORIGINAL "Botanical Study" desktop, lush huge sculptural monstera leaves with cream sunlight and sage minimal widgets; its cream footer has theme name, "8 widgets", heart and terracotta "Apply theme" button. A narrower stacked right column has "Clay Forms" — museum-quality matte terracotta and cream sculptural circles with simple widgets — and "Ocean Ink" — beautiful hand-painted indigo ink waves on handmade paper with navy widgets. Below: heading "The studio collection", three refined landscape preview cards "Linen Light" tactile off-white linen with sparse graphite widgets, "Apricot Hour" abstract soft apricot curved shapes with orange widgets, "Forest Notes" quiet dark emerald fern still-life with warm ivory widgets. Thoughtful card proportions, no card overlaps, realistic desktop previews. Small understated "Designed to feel like you." label at sidebar bottom. Beautiful sophisticated art direction with restrained material texture, no decorative clutter.

Layout: slim upper native title bar All Set at left and small navigation "Themes" selected, "Widgets", "Wallpapers", "Favorites" at center. Main header huge "Find your frequency." with small "THEMES / DISCOVER" eyebrow and search to the right. Main area uses a dynamic unequal grid: a tall 45%-width hero on the left, two medium landscape cards stacked in middle, a narrow right column with editorial theme details. Hero theme "Electric Iris" uses an original striking macro abstract purple iris petal sculpture against nearly black background, droplets and vivid lime small desk clock/calendar/weather widgets; subtle floating "FEATURED" pill and simple bottom name. Middle top "Liquid Chrome": fluid polished silver loop forms on burgundy red with coordinated thin white widgets. Middle bottom "Signal Orange": minimal vivid orange poster-like geometric arch and a black sun disc, paired black and ivory widgets. Right details heading "Electric Iris", "09 widgets", short copy "A sharper kind of calm.", lime solid "Apply theme" button, outlined "Preview", heart icon, four miniature swatches matching wallpaper colors. Under the hero grid, a restrained category row "All", "Bold", "Calm", "Monochrome", "Organic". Bottom row of smaller horizontal theme previews "Cobalt Flow" artistic blue silk wave, "Paper Orbit" cream cut-paper circles, "Moss Circuit" olive-green topographic abstraction. Every preview includes a few well-arranged real desktop widgets. Strong image-led composition, premium commercial product UI, no oversized empty panels.

Layout: compact 165px pale left sidebar with All Set wordmark, Themes selected blue, Widgets, Wallpapers, Favorites, bottom Settings. Main top "Themes" header and search. Below header segmented categories "All themes", "Minimal", "Art", "Nature". Main area split: left 62% contains a large beautiful selected desktop preview with original wallpaper "Prism Air": luminous translucent glass folded ribbons, pale aqua and lilac refraction on a soft pearl background, minimalist charcoal clock 10:28, frosted weather 21°, calendar and compact music widget elegantly positioned, all legible. Under this desktop preview a horizontal row of four small coordinated preview cards "Prism Air" selected blue border, "Sand Layers" sculpted beige contour dunes, "Blue Hour" abstract cobalt and lavender mesh waves, "Quiet Marble" white travertine and veined mineral photography. Right 30% is a refined inspector-style panel titled "Prism Air", "Wallpaper + 7 widgets", three stacked tidy rows of widget thumbnail/icon with labels "Clock", "Weather", "Calendar", subtle "Includes 4 more widgets" text. Small color swatch circles, tidy toggle rows "Include wallpaper" on, "Keep my layout" on. Prominent cobalt "Apply theme" button then small secondary "Preview on desktop". Lower main area heading "Explore a different mood" with two wider landscape cards "Copper Fold" copper sculptural paper with cream widgets and "Mint Garden" light pastel botanical illustration with navy widgets. Balanced desktop preview and useful controls; clean continuous geometry; sophisticated realistic materials. No mountain scenery.
